intervals.locator: INSPIRE experiment record 1109311, fields date_approved and date_started (construction interval bounded by these, not independently sourced)
intervals.note: Bounded by the CERN LEPC approval date and ALEPH's first measured events; no separate detector-construction date sourced.

intervals.label: operation
intervals.quote: ALEPH first measured events in LEP in July 1989.

calorimeters.quote: an electromagnetic calorimeter to identify electrons and photons; a hadron calorimeter to detect hadrons
calorimeters.value: Electromagnetic calorimeter to identify electrons and photons; hadron calorimeter to detect hadrons

solenoid_field.quote: a superconducting coil, 6.3 metres long and 5.3 metres in diameter, to provide the 1.5 tesla magnetic field

tracker.quote: a vertex detector composed of two layers of double-sided silicon microstrips; an inner drift-chamber that provided 8 tracking coordinates and a trigger signal for charged particles from the interaction point; a time projection chamber - 4.4 metres long and 3.6 metres in diameter
tracker.value: Silicon-microstrip vertex detector (two double-sided layers), 8-coordinate inner drift chamber with trigger, and a 4.4 m x 3.6 m time projection chamber

description.quote: a time projection chamber - 4.4 metres long and 3.6 metres in diameter - to detect charged particles
description.value: 4.4 m long, 3.6 m in diameter, the central charged-particle tracker.

description.quote: a superconducting coil, 6.3 metres long and 5.3 metres in diameter, to provide the 1.5 tesla magnetic field
description.value: 6.3 m long, 5.3 m in diameter, providing a 1.5 T magnetic field.

summary.plain: A cylindrical, general-purpose detector at LEP's Point 4, built around a giant gas chamber and a superconducting magnet to track and identify particles from electron-positron collisions.
summary.technical: General-purpose LEP detector: silicon-microstrip vertex detector (two double-sided layers), an 8-coordinate inner drift chamber with trigger, a 4.4 m x 3.6 m time projection chamber, electromagnetic and hadron calorimeters, and a 6.3 m x 5.3 m superconducting coil providing a 1.5 T field.

technology.quote: a large superconducting coil enclosing a Time Projection Chamber as central track detector
technology.value: General-purpose collider detector with a large-volume time projection chamber inside a superconducting solenoid
